function.name: detect_beats_and_filter
function.description: Analyzes an audio file to detect beats and filters them based on confidence levels and timing. Returns a list of times in seconds, each representing the occurrence of a significant beat within the audio file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

capture_percentage.description: Filters beats by excluding those below a specified confidence percentile. Values range from 0 to 100 (inclusive).

confidence_window_size.description: Selects the highest confidence beat within a given time window in seconds (e.g., 0.5), to ensure distinct beats are chosen in that period. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
User says "I dont want any beats". They likely want to analyze audio but filter out all beats? Or they don't want any beats detected. Maybe they want to set capture_percentage to 0 or something. But the function requires capture_percentage between 0 and 100 inclusive. If we set capture_percentage to 0, it will exclude beats below 0% confidence, meaning all beats above 0% will be included. That would include all beats. To exclude all beats, we could set capture_percentage to 100, so only beats with confidence >=100% are kept. But if no beats have 100% confidence, then none will be returned. Alternatively, we can set confidence_window_size to a very large number to pick only one beat? But they want no beats. So we can set capture_percentage to 100 and confidence_window_size to something like 1.0. That will filter out all beats unless some beat has 100% confidence. But we can't guarantee. But maybe we can set capture_percentage to 100 and confidence_window_size to 0.1. That will keep only beats with confidence >=100%. That likely returns empty list.

Thus we call the function with capture_percentage=100, confidence_window_size=0.1.
